title: Forklift Rental
content:
Forklift Rental Dubai & UAE. Diesel, Electric & Counterbalance

Fast Delivery, Flexible Terms

S&P Heavy Machinery offers diesel and electric forklift rental in Dubai and across all Emirates. Ideal for construction sites, logistics hubs, warehouses, and factories.

REQUEST A QUOTE
VIEW SERVICES

Forklift Rental in the UAE – Fast, Safe & Affordable

Need a forklift truck for rent? S&P Heavy Machinery provides a wide selection of forklifts for construction, logistics, and warehousing operations across the UAE. We offer competitive rates, fast delivery, and 24/7 support. Whether you’re lifting pallets in Sharjah, unloading cargo in Dubai, or organizing warehouse stock in Abu Dhabi, we’ve got you covered.

Forklift Types

Our Forklift Range Includes:

Diesel
Forklifts

Diesel forklifts (2.5 to 10 tons) are built for strength and endurance, making them the top choice for outdoor environments such as construction sites, shipping yards, and industrial complexes. These models offer higher torque and lifting capacity (Up to 6 meters), ideal for transporting heavy loads over rough terrain or uneven surfaces.

Electric
Forklifts

Electric forklifts (1.5 to 3.5 tons) are perfect for indoor use, offering clean, quiet, and efficient operation. They're highly maneuverable and emit no fumes, which makes them suitable for warehouses, distribution centers, and enclosed manufacturing spaces. With minimal maintenance requirements and low noise levels, electric forklifts help maintain air quality and safety standards, especially in food, pharmaceutical, and retail environments.

Counterbalance
Forklifts

Counterbalance forklifts (1.5 to 7 tons) are the most versatile and widely used type of forklift. They feature a weighted rear end to counter the load in front, allowing them to lift heavy items without the need for outriggers. Available in electric and diesel variants, they’re ideal for both indoor and outdoor lifting (Up to 6 meters), from warehouse pallets to construction materials.

Pallet Jacks & Reach Trucks

Designed for efficiency and space-saving, pallet jacks and reach trucks (1 to 2.5 tons) are essential tools for internal logistics. Pallet jacks are perfect for short-distance transport of goods on pallets, while reach trucks are ideal for high stacking (Up to 10 meters) in narrow aisles. These compact machines are a staple in warehouse operations, enabling fast and safe material handling even in tight spaces.

Why Rent a Forklift from S&P Heavy Machinery?

  • Well-maintained forklifts from trusted global brands
  • Quick dispatch across all Emirates
  • Short- and long-term hire (daily, weekly, monthly)
  • Operator services and safety-certified machines
  • 24/7 client support and site consultation
  • Discounted rates for repeat customers
  • “Forklift rental near me” – we deliver wherever you are in the UAE

Typical Use Cases

Our clients rent forklifts for:

Construction site lifting

Warehouse and logistics operations

Retail stock handling

Port and container unloading

Industrial plant operations

Events and temporary site setups

Not Sure What You Need?

No problem – our experts will help you choose the right forklift

Choosing the right forklift depends on:

  • Load weight and height requirements
  • Indoor vs. outdoor use
  • Surface type and maneuverability needs
  • Fuel type preference (diesel vs. electric)

Our team can guide you! Just tell us about your load weight, work environment, and space constraints — we’ll match you with the best machine

Talk to an Expert
Request a Custom Quote

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Can I rent a forklift for just one day?

Yes! We offer daily, weekly, and monthly forklift rental plans across the UAE.

Do you provide forklift operators?

Yes, licensed operators are available as an add-on for any rental.

Can you deliver to remote Emirates like Fujairah or RAK?

Absolutely. We deliver to all locations in the UAE, including free zones and remote worksites.

Are your forklifts safety certified?

Yes. All our forklifts units are inspected before every dispatch and comply with UAE working-at-height regulations, including Dubai Municipality guidelines and OSHAD standards applicable to Abu Dhabi projects.

Can I get a forklift truck rental near me on short notice?

Yes. With depots across the Emirates, we can often deliver the same day.

What is the minimum rental period for a forklift?

Our minimum rental period is one day. We offer daily, weekly, and monthly rental plans, so you only pay for the time you actually need whether it’s a one-day or a long-term project.

Need Help Choosing?

Not sure what machine suits your job?

Our rental specialists are ready to guide you through the process and suggest the best-fit solution. Whether it’s urgent delivery or custom setups, we’re here to help — fast

All rentals include equipment inspection, expert setup advice, and optional add-ons like fuel delivery or operator services.

Contact us now

title: Scaffold Rental
content:
Scaffold rental across the UAE

safe and flexible access systems for every job site

S&P Heavy Machinery provides trusted scaffold rental across the United Arab Emirates, supporting projects in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, and beyond. Whether you need mobile scaffolds, suspended platforms, or frame scaffolding, we deliver fast and set you up for safe, productive work at height.

Our scaffolding is available for short or long-term hire with full inspection, optional setup services, and rapid delivery across all Emirates.

REQUEST A QUOTE

Our scaffold rental options

We offer various types of scaffolding solutions for construction, renovation, inspection, and maintenance projects. Our inventory includes:

Mobile Towers

Aluminum mobile scaffold towers with wheeled base frames with the heights from 2m to 8m. Suitable for indoor ceilings, external painting, electrical works, and fit-out tasks. SWL and platform dimensions confirmed at time of booking based on your job requirements.

Frame Scaffolding

Standard vertical frames in standard bay widths, scalable to multi-level configurations for façade work and building construction. Maximum erected height and SWL per bay confirmed based on your site load requirements.

Suspended Platforms

Motorized and manual suspended access platforms for high-rise façade maintenance, glass cleaning, and external works. Platform lengths and SWL confirmed at time of booking. All suspended systems supplied with safety harnesses.

Accessories and Add-ons

Guardrails, toe boards, ladder extensions, stabilizers, and base jacks, available with every rental upon request.

Why rent scaffolding from S&P Heavy Machinery?

  • All scaffolds safety-checked before every rental
  • Delivery to every Emirate — from Abu Dhabi to Fujairah
  • Setup guidance or full installation available on request
  • Daily, weekly, and project-based rentals
  • UAE-compliant equipment, OSHA-referenced standards
  • Free PPE (helmets, gloves, cones) on qualifying rentals

Who rents our scaffolding?

We serve:

  • General construction and civil contractors
  • Interior fit-out and MEP teams
  • Maintenance and cleaning providers
  • Event staging and temporary structure planners

Our scaffolds are used in projects from Dubai towers to Sharjah showrooms and Abu Dhabi industrial sites.

Where our scaffolding makes a difference

From large-scale construction projects to fast-paced interior renovations, our scaffolding systems are trusted across the UAE. Clients rely on us for:

  • Safe façade access during building construction
  • Elevated platforms for ceiling and lighting works
  • Stable towers for painting and MEP installations
  • Suspended systems for high-rise window cleaning
  • Temporary staging setups for public events and exhibitions

No matter the industry or location, we deliver access solutions that keep workers safe and projects on schedule.

Built with safety and compliance in mind

At S&P Heavy Machinery, safety is never an afterthought. All our scaffolding systems meet the regulatory standards outlined by UAE labor authorities and are aligned with international guidelines such as OSHA and EN standards. Each scaffold is inspected before dispatch, and we provide setup support to ensure secure assembly on-site.

We understand that job site safety isn’t just a legal requirement — it’s a vital part of productivity and peace of mind. That’s why we maintain high safety standards and offer training and setup guidance with every rental when needed. Whether you’re managing a single-story fit-out or a multi-level construction, we help you protect your crew while staying compliant.

FREqUeNTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Can I rent scaffolding for short-term use?

Yes. We offer flexible terms including one-day and weekend rentals.

Are your scaffolds safe and certified?

Yes. All our scaffolding units are inspected before every dispatch and comply with UAE working-at-height regulations, including Dubai Municipality guidelines and OSHAD standards applicable to Abu Dhabi projects. Our equipment meets EN and OSHA-referenced safety standards, and every scaffold is dispatched with a pre-use inspection record.

Do you deliver and install?

Yes, across all Emirates. Our crew can assist with installation if needed.

What height can your scaffolds reach?

Our systems scale up to 15 meters depending on type and site conditions. Custom solutions available.

Do you provide scaffolding for indoor work?

Yes. We rent mobile scaffold towers ideal for indoor maintenance, lighting, and fit-out jobs.

Do you erect and dismantle the scaffolding?

Yes. We offer full erection and dismantling services across Dubai and UAE, carried out by trained scaffolders familiar with UAE site safety requirements. 

Not sure what you need?

We’re here to help.

Choosing the right scaffolding can be confusing — but we make it easy. Whether you’re working indoors or at height, on a short job or a long-term project, our experts will help you pick the safest and most cost-effective solution.

Let us match your site needs with the right equipment
